messages:
alex.m: heads-up: master CI is red on linux-builder-12 after yesterday's toolchain image roll. Linking fails for binaries that use our json runtime lib.

ci-bot: Build #86923 failed on linux-builder-12 — link errors. https://ci.internal/86923 :x:

alex.m: log snippet:
```
/usr/bin/ld: cannot find -ljsonrt
collect2: error: ld returned 1 exit status
```

dina: @alex.m checking. Is this only with CMake targets or Bazel too?

raj: I see failures in both Bazel and CMake stacks. Likely the new gcc image removed the json runtime package (libjsonrt) or changed soname.

sam: I started a quick bisect: pushed a PR that pins the previous toolchain image in CI: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/4521 :sparkles:

alex.m: thanks. Can you also try `apt-file list` on the image or docker run to see package name? Might be jsoncpp -> jsonrt rename.

raj: short-term fix: add -L/usr/local/lib/jsonrt or install libjsonrt-dev in CI image. Long-term: update package mapping in our toolchain bundle.

dina: I'll open an infra ticket and coord with images team. If we need emergency rollback we can revert the image tag. assigning @dina

ci-bot: Rerun requested for job 86923 (user: sam). Use `/rerun 86923` in the job thread.

alex.m: :thumbsup: will follow up if the pinned-image PR gets green, otherwise revert.
